name: didim-mcp
description: Codex plugin that ships Didim MCP setup/usage skills and helper scripts. It does not register an MCP server itself; the setup script writes the server config into the user's config.toml.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and use Didim MCP safely from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Deploys two skills (first-time setup and safe usage) plus PowerShell/CMD helper scripts. Ask Codex to "Didim MCP 설정해줘" to configure your personal API key into ~/.codex/config.toml; related questions then apply the usage skill automatically.
defaultPrompt: Show the Didim MCP tools available to me.
